workflows.name: month-end-close
workflows.purpose: Run the monthly close: baseline the ledger, dry-run the period-close journal, confirm counts, capture an explicit human approval, write live, re-verify.

workflows.name: production-deploy
workflows.purpose: Promote a build candidate to production. Always gated by a human approval; the workflow refuses to schedule.

workflows.name: customer-acquisition
workflows.purpose: Weekly customer-acquisition allocation review: read the agent's recommendation, apply approved shifts, monitor the change against the CAC payback metric.

workflows.name: incident-response
workflows.purpose: Orchestrate a declared incident from declaration through retrospective. Cross-cutting workflow that lives at the runtime layer because it spans every module. Always human-led. The commander is a person, not an agent.
